## [Product quality, shipping experience and returns all lacking](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a1eedd6f9190cddf7951fbf)
The curtain panels I ordered were not true to the advertised dimensions -- they were a bit shorter than the length they were stated to be. Returns are not easy. The website didn't process my return even though I am well within the return window and am otherwise eligible for 30-day returns given the price I paid. I am still waiting for an email response from customer service after 2 days. Given I paid $1,500, I find that the quality of the product and the customer service to be lacking significantly. Of lesser concern is that the curtain panels arrived folded messy and in a bag that wasn't sealed, like it had been returned by a prior customer and not re-folded and packaged with any care. Very disappointing.

May 21, 2026
